title: This Free Tool Cuts Your AI Agent Token Costs by 95% (Built by a Netflix Engineer)
description:
A Netflix engineer just dropped a free GitHub repo that stops AI agents from burning tokens for no reason — and it's called Headroom.

Here's how it works:

Before anything reaches the LLM, Headroom compresses everything your agent is about to read:

📋 Tool outputs
📁 Files & logs
🔍 Code search results
💬 Conversation history

Same answers. 60–95% fewer tokens. That's not a rounding error — that's your Claude Code plan lasting 3–5x longer.

And it works with everything you're already using:

✅ Python & TypeScript libraries
✅ Local proxy or any MCP server
✅ Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Copilot wrappers

Built by Tejas Chopra at Netflix. Free and open source.

Comment "free" and I'll send you the link 👇
